invariants.rationale: The method returns true if and only if the order's quantity is at least 10.
If result is false, then order.getQuantity() must be less than 10; logical implication of the return.
If result is true, then order.getQuantity() must be at least 10; logical implication of the return.
The method always receives a non-null order object for processing.
Order quantity is likely non-negative, as negative quantities do not make sense in this context.
